name: io.github.tonyyang0504/twitch-messaging-mcp
description: Twitch (messaging): me, send, reply. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TWITCH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Twitch app client id (dev.twitch.tv console); also sent as the Client-Id header on every Helix call.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Twitch app client secret (form body of the refresh request to https://id.twitch.tv/oauth2/token).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TWITCH_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: User refresh token from the authorization-code flow with scopes user:manage:whispers and user:write:chat. Twitch may return a new refresh token: the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/twitch.json (mode 0600). The state file is keyed by platform id, so it is shared with social/twitch: give each server its own PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR (or its own consent / refresh token) so the two never race on one single-use refresh token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TWITCH_SENDER_ID
environmentVariables.description: User id of the token's user (GET /helix/users with the token): from_user_id of whispers and sender_id of chat replies. It 'must match the user ID in the user access token'; the account needs a verified phone number to whisper.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TWITCH_BROADCASTER_ID
environmentVariables.description: User id of the channel whose chat reply posts into (needed only for reply).
